warnings: One of 3 views on this sheet; siblings are the gate elevation (_view1_gate_elevation.json) and gate section (_view2_gate_section.json). This detail is cross-referenced from view1's 'กลอนประตู (ดูแบบขยาย)' callout.

This 1:10 detail (finer scale than the other two 1:25 views) shows the sliding gate's latch/lock mechanism: a welded round pin passing through a drilled plate on the post side, engaged from the gate-leaf side, with a padlock hole for securing.
